newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Five killed in light plane crash in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in light plane crash in Australia.

text.p: Five people died on Thursday when a light plane crashed near the small outback town of Katherine, 230 km (140 miles) south of here, police said.
The pilot and four passengers died when the six-seater, single engine Cessna aircraft crashed late Thursday afternoon, a police spokeswoman said.
She said details were sketchy and that air safety inspectors would arrive on Friday to examine the wreck for clues to the cause of the crash.
